kind: Planning scenarios, NOT actual utility bills or quotes
summary: Based on Oncor-area Nov 2026 market electricity rates, Fort Worth 2027 published water/wastewater and drainage fees, and Burleson 2026-27 public residential rates. Rates and service territory require final meter/address confirmation.
householdAssumptions: 4 people, regular home-day occupancy, single-story 1,758 and 2,044 sf houses. kWh varies with HVAC, insulation, heating fuel, thermostats and seasonal load. Water 6,000/10,000/16,000 gallons per month; wastewater billed on assumed winter average 7,000 gallons and varies on actual account. Normal trash cart, no large special water demand.
exclusions: Metered natural gas (if gas equipment exists), because service/fuel is unverified; gas use may reduce electric heating demand, so do not blindly add a gas bill to an all-electric assumption
Internet, optional streaming and mobile phone service
Renters insurance, one-time deposits, utility connection costs and taxes/surcharges not expressly modeled
Landscaping/sod and irrigation upgrades, new appliances, extraordinary summer cooling/heat or water leaks

scenarios.label: Lower-use month
scenarios.notes: Efficient-use month; especially not a summer maximum

scenarios.notes: Midpoint planning case; not a forecast of actual monthly weather

scenarios.label: Higher-use month
scenarios.notes: Higher energy and more yard watering; extreme Texas summer peaks can exceed this

ratesAssumed.electricity: Nov25 DFW Oncor retail plan index median around 13.2 cents/kWh at 1000 kWh, including delivery; use 12–14 cents/kWh as scenario price, no bill-credit cliff assumed.
ratesAssumed.fortWorth: 2027 5/8-inch water fixed $14.45, residential tiered volume $2.28/$3.19/$4.35 per CCF; sewer fixed $8.35+$4.33/CCF at 7k gallon winter average; assumed 64-gallon trash $23.40; stormwater approx Tier2 $7.65 from Jan 2027.
ratesAssumed.burleson: 2026-27 5/8-inch water fixed $19.27+$5.89/kgal to 10k and $7.11 next; sewer $23.28+$6.46/kgal of winter average 7k; trash $26.49 plus potential tax; typical stormwater $8 Tier2, exact lot tier unknown.
